not_scored.staff: a layout container, not a printed symbol
not_scored.chord: a grouping of notes already scored individually
not_scored.stem: detected by classical CV, never boxed by the detector
not_scored.label: the instrument name — read by the margin-label reader, not YOLO
not_scored.text: free text — read by `direction_text` with OCR
not_scored.dir: a direction word — read by `direction_text` with OCR
